title: Sweet Lemons and Golden Honey  (芬芳的柠檬与金色蜂蜜)

segments.t: 沿着林登街再往下走两个街区，五颜六色的遮阳篷让周六集市广场充满了生机。汉娜和泰莎停在一堆刚摘下的柑橘小山前，这时欧文正好拎着一袋水果走过。先完整听一遍这一幕。
Smell the skin of this lemon, Hannah, like sunshine after rain!
How many kilos do we need for Friday's tarts and hot tea?
Three kilos of lemons and two big glass jars of flower honey.
Good morning! Need an extra pair of arms for those heavy jars?
Owen! You found the neighborhood market already!
I grew up three streets from this square. Nothing smells better on Saturday.
Taste a spoon of this dark mountain honey, Owen. Is it too sweet?
Not at all. Warm and rich, just like my mother bought in autumn.
Two big jars and three kilos of lemons, paid in cash with coins to spare!
Give me the heavy basket with the glass jars; you take the herbs.
Next stop: the pottery table at the corner for twelve white teacups!
Lead the way, Tessa! We are ahead of budget already!
现在我们来逐句仔细看看。
Smell the skin of this lemon, Hannah, like sunshine after rain!
'闻闻这颗柠檬的果皮，汉娜，就像雨后的阳光一样！' 水果的表皮或果皮和人的皮肤用的是同一个词，
the skin of this lemon,
而 sunshine 则浓缩了温暖的阳光。
How many kilos do we need for Friday's tarts and hot tea?
'周五的小塔和热茶我们需要几公斤？' 带撇号的所有格同样适用于星期几，比如
Friday's tarts
这种表达非常利落简练。
Three kilos of lemons and two big glass jars of flower honey.
'三公斤柠檬和两大玻璃罐百花蜜。' 描述容器时，大小尺寸要放在材质前面：
big glass jars
先把 big 放在前面，然后是 glass，最后才是 jars。
Good morning! Need an extra pair of arms for those heavy jars?
'早上好！那些沉甸甸的罐子需要多一双手帮忙吗？' 用亲切形象的说法主动提供帮助，可以这样地道地表达：
an extra pair of arms
因为集市上口吻亲切随意，句首省略了 Do you。
Owen! You found the neighborhood market already!
'欧文！你已经找到社区集市啦！' 把
already!
放在感叹句末尾，突出了这么早在那里见到他的惊喜。
I grew up three streets from this square. Nothing smells better on Saturday.
'我就在离这个广场三条街的地方长大。周六没有什么比这里的味道更香了。' 讲述一个人在哪里度过童年时，要用到不规则过去式
I grew up
（grow up 的过去式）。
Taste a spoon of this dark mountain honey, Owen. Is it too sweet?
'尝一勺这种深色山花蜜吧，欧文。是不是太甜了？' 询问某种味道是否过头时，
too sweet?
用 too 来表示“过分、太”。
Not at all. Warm and rich, just like my mother bought in autumn.
'一点也不。温润又醇厚，正像我妈妈秋天买的那种。' 要干脆又礼貌地打消对方的疑虑，可以用
Not at all.
而用于食物时，rich 相当于“味道浓郁、醇厚”。
Two big jars and three kilos of lemons, paid in cash with coins to spare!
'两大罐蜂蜜和三公斤柠檬，现金结清，还多出几个硬币！' 当钱或时间还有富余时，会在名词后面加上短语
with coins to spare!
其中 to spare 的意思是“富余、多出来的”。
Give me the heavy basket with the glass jars; you take the herbs.
'把装着玻璃罐的重篮子给我；你们拿着香草。' 现场分配任务时，祈使句前显式加上代词的表达
you take the herbs.
突出了各自拿的东西之间的对比。
Next stop: the pottery table at the corner for twelve white teacups!
'下一站：街角的陶瓷摊，去买十二个白色茶杯！' 陶器或烧制陶土餐具可以统称为
pottery table
这个词与 pot（壶、罐或花盆）同源。
Lead the way, Tessa! We are ahead of budget already!
'你来带路吧，泰莎！我们现在花得比预算还少呢！' 请人走在前面带路时可以说
Lead the way,
而 ahead of budget 则高兴地表示花费比原计划还要少。我们再来完整听一遍这一幕。
Smell the skin of this lemon, Hannah, like sunshine after rain!
How many kilos do we need for Friday's tarts and hot tea?
Three kilos of lemons and two big glass jars of flower honey.
Good morning! Need an extra pair of arms for those heavy jars?
Owen! You found the neighborhood market already!
I grew up three streets from this square. Nothing smells better on Saturday.
Taste a spoon of this dark mountain honey, Owen. Is it too sweet?
Not at all. Warm and rich, just like my mother bought in autumn.
Two big jars and three kilos of lemons, paid in cash with coins to spare!
Give me the heavy basket with the glass jars; you take the herbs.
Next stop: the pottery table at the corner for twelve white teacups!
Lead the way, Tessa! We are ahead of budget already!
三公斤清香的柠檬和两大罐沉甸甸的蜂蜜已经稳稳地拿在欧文手里了。接下来我们就去街角的陶瓷摊。
See you later!
